title: Regular City Council Meeting 02/03/26
caveat: Findings from an automated review of an auto-captioned recording. Verify specifics against the video before repeating them.

findings.meeting_summary: The Mattoon City Council approved consent items, fire station bay improvements, a utility billing adjustment, and administrative services for a Little Wabash River piping project. Council members also held an extended discussion regarding public notification procedures for winter snow routes and municipal boil orders following a recent water main break.
